name: Open-Question
description: Ask a genuine open-ended question that invites diverse answers
example: What's the one PM skill you wish you learned earlier? Drop it below.

name: Poll-Vote
description: Present 2-4 options and ask people to vote in comments
example: Which matters more for a PM? A) Technical skills B) Communication C) Empathy. Vote below.

name: Share-Your-Story
description: Invite readers to share their own related experience
example: Have you ever shipped something nobody used? Tell me your story in the comments.

name: Tag-Someone
description: Ask readers to tag someone who needs to see this
example: Tag a PM who needs to hear this today.

name: Agreement-Check
description: Ask if people agree or disagree to spark debate
example: Agree or disagree: every PM should code for at least 6 months. Tell me why.

name: Reflection-Prompt
description: Ask readers to reflect on their own situation
example: When was the last time you talked to an actual customer? Think about it.

name: Challenge-CTA
description: Challenge the audience to take a specific action
example: Challenge: this week ask one 'why' question in every meeting. See what changes.

name: Resource-Offer
description: Offer a free resource in exchange for engagement
example: I made a template for this. Comment 'TEMPLATE' and I'll send it to you.

name: Follow-For-More
description: Direct invitation to follow for more content on this topic
example: If you found this useful I write about PM frameworks every week. Hit follow.

name: Agree-Disagree
description: Simple binary choice to lower the barrier to commenting
example: Agree or disagree? Drop a 👍 or 👎 in the comments.

name: Save-This
description: Tell readers to save/bookmark the post for future reference
example: Save this for your next stakeholder meeting. You'll thank yourself later.

name: Comment-Below
description: Direct ask for comments with a specific prompt
example: What would you add to this list? I know I missed some good ones.

name: DM-Me
description: Invite private messages for deeper conversation
example: If you're going through something similar DM me. Happy to chat.

name: Try-This
description: Ask readers to try your advice and report back
example: Try this in your next 1-on-1 and let me know what happens.

name: What-Would-You-Do
description: Present a scenario and ask readers for their approach
example: Your CEO wants to launch in 2 weeks. The feature is 60% done. What do you do?

name: Fill-in-Blank
description: Give an incomplete sentence for readers to complete
example: The hardest part of being a PM is ________. Fill in the blank.

name: Hot-Take-Invite
description: Invite readers to share their own hot takes
example: What's your most unpopular PM opinion? I'll go first in the comments.

name: Repost-Request
description: Ask readers to repost if they found value
example: If this helped you it'll probably help someone in your network too. Hit repost.

name: One-Word-Answer
description: Ask for a one-word response to maximize comment volume
example: Describe your PM career in one word. Mine: chaos.

name: Advice-Request
description: Ask for advice showing you're still learning
example: I'm working on getting better at this. What's worked for you?

name: Prediction-Ask
description: Ask readers to predict a future trend or outcome
example: Where do you think PM roles will be in 3 years? I shared mine. Now your turn.

name: Rate-This
description: Ask readers to rate something on a scale
example: On a scale of 1-10 how important is SQL for a PM? I say 6.

name: This-or-That
description: Present two options and ask which one readers prefer
example: Product sense or analytical skills — which one gets you hired faster?

name: Story-Continuation
description: Ask readers what happened next or what they think should happen
example: What would you have done differently? Tell me in the comments.

name: Accountability
description: Publicly commit to something and invite others to join
example: I'm committing to writing one LinkedIn post every day for 30 days. Who's joining me?

name: Controversial-Pick
description: Share your pick and ask readers for theirs
example: Best PM book ever written? I'll fight anyone who doesn't say Inspired. What's yours?

name: Experience-Level
description: Ask readers to respond based on their experience level
example: Junior PMs — what's confusing you right now? Senior PMs — what do you wish juniors knew?

name: Myth-Check
description: Present a common belief and ask if readers agree it's a myth
example: Is 'the customer is always right' actually true? What's your experience?

name: Gratitude-Prompt
description: Ask readers to share gratitude about a professional moment
example: Who's someone at work who made your career better? Give them a shoutout below.

name: Quick-Tip-Exchange
description: Share one tip and ask for one in return
example: Here's my best meeting hack. Now give me yours. Best one gets a shoutout next week.

name: Finish-the-List
description: Share an incomplete list and ask readers to add to it
example: I listed 5. I know there are more. What did I miss?

name: Emoji-Response
description: Ask readers to respond with just an emoji
example: Drop a 🔥 if you've lived through this. Drop a 😅 if you're living it right now.
